summary: Show Recycled Action Plan Item Assignee
description: Details of a single Recycled Action Plan Item Assignee

id.description: Unique identifier for this recycled Action Plan Item Assignee.

plan_item_id.description: ID of the Action Plan Item this assignee belonged to.

created_at.description: Timestamp in ISO 8601 format when this assignee was created.

deleted_at.description: Timestamp in ISO 8601 format when this assignee was deleted.

is_holding.description: Whether the assignee was required to sign for a hold point before deletion.

is_locked.description: Whether the assignee was added prior to the Action Plan's approval.

first_name.description: First name of the Party Person

last_name.description: Last name of the Party Person

name.description: Full name of the Party Person

user_id.description: User ID of the login account associated with this party person.

is_employee.description: Whether this party person is an employee of the current company, as opposed to an external vendor contact.

employee_id.description: Employee ID string for this party person. Null if no employee ID is assigned.

login.description: Email address (login) of the party person's user account.

updated_at.description: Time the Party Person was updated

id.description: Unique identifier of the vendor company this party person belongs to.

name.description: Name of the vendor company this party person belongs to.

plan_id.description: ID of the Action Plan this assignee's item belonged to before deletion.

role.description: Organizational role this assignee held on the Action Plan Item.

role_id.description: ID of the role record assigned to this Action Plan Item Assignee. Null when the assignee was added by party rather than by role.

id.description: Unique identifier for this item assignee signature record.
Unique identifier of the Prostore file containing the signature image.

content_type.description: MIME type of the signature file.

name.description: File name of the uploaded signature image.

url.description: URL to download the signature image. The URL is temporary and expires after a period.

captured_at.description: Timestamp in ISO 8601 format when this signature was captured.

first_name.description: First name of the Party Person

last_name.description: Last name of the Party Person

name.description: Full name of the Party Person

user_id.description: User ID of the login account associated with this party person.

is_employee.description: Indicates whether Party is an Employee of the current Company

employee_id.description: Employee ID of this party person. Null if no employee ID is assigned.

login.description: Email address (login) of the party person's user account.

updated_at.description: Timestamp in ISO 8601 format when this party person record was last updated.
Timestamp in ISO 8601 format when this assignee was last updated.

id.description: Unique identifier for this verification method.

active.description: Whether this verification method is currently available for assignment. Inactive methods may still appear on existing assignees.

name.description: Display name of the verification method (e.g., Hold Point, Witness Point, Review Record).

source_key.description: Machine-readable key for this verification method. Use for programmatic comparisons rather than the display name.
